book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 KORIN Korin mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge amboŋga kuyarna

content: Ye Kristus tuku maŋau kumumba dubiwet. Taŋamba ndo tane mata ye tuku maŋau dubiwap.
Gabat soŋgam tuku pasa
Tane ye pasa satiŋgen te bige magede tukunu ye gare-gareka tane mayede ŋget ta
ye kile wam ande tane katesewap ŋga satiŋgamŋgit ta teŋenmba. Taŋgo tuku gabat Kristus. Pino tuku gabat nuŋe taŋgo nuŋe. Kristus tuku gabat Kuate.
Taŋgo ande nu gabat soŋganu ŋak Kuate yabaŋte ko Tukul Guwa tugumŋge pasa ismba kile-mayokkate ta nu Kristus kiko pilete.
Pino ande nu gabat so ndaŋga Kuate yabaŋte ko Tukul Guwa tugumŋge pasa ismba kile-mayokkate ta nu mata nuŋe taŋgo nuŋe kiko pilete. Nu tuku gabat kuerke sulude le kiko tate taŋaŋ.
Pino ande nu gabat soŋgam mbulmba ndeta andeŋge nu tuku gabat waŋe kuer suluwa. Taŋawa le nu ta tuku kikowa le nu gabat soŋguwa.
Taŋgo nane gabat so ndaŋguwaig. Kuate nuŋe suk taŋgo wakeina le nu Kuate tuku kanumnu taŋaŋ minit. Pino nane gabat soŋguwaig. Pino nu taŋgo tuku kanumnu taŋaŋ minit.
Kuate nu pino tuku ŋgarosu inumnumbi taŋgo wakei ndana. Kuga. Nu taŋgo tuku ŋgarosu inumnumbi pino wakeina.
Nu pino tuku ŋga taŋgo wakei ndana. Kuga. Nu taŋgo tuku ŋga pino wakeina.
Ta tuku pino kame nane taŋgo kame kumnemŋge minig ta te-mayokam tuku gabat soŋguwaig le eŋel kame nane kaŋgerkuwaig.
Sine Suŋgo ndoŋ ulendikeg mbal sine taŋgo pino yimyam mine ndakeg. Sine muŋgu turturkam tuku mineg.
Kuate nu taŋgo tuku ŋgarosu inumnu tumba pino wakeina. Kile pino tuku ŋgarosu mbolŋge taŋgo mayok kinig. Agaŋ ndende ŋakmba Kuate nu tugu.
Taŋgine miroŋ maŋau te pileŋgap. Pino nu gabat so ndaŋga nu Kuate yabaŋte ta nu wam mayete e ko kuga?

Ata. Tane idusap. Pino nu gabat mapete le kuen kinit ta sine maŋau mayenu ŋgeg. Kuateŋge nuŋe nane tumail pulukam tuku mindepiye taŋaŋ niŋgina. Taŋgo nu gabat waŋe mapete le kuen kinit ta sine ŋakmba nu talamba kiko maŋau ŋgeg.
Ande nu pino gabat so ndaŋgam tuku saŋgri tiŋga kualeyaukam bafuwa ta ye nu sawamŋgit. Sine aposel kame Kuate tuku kuasmbi ŋakmba pino kame gabat soŋganu ŋak maŋau ta ndo dubiweg ŋga sawamŋgit.
Pasa nyam tuku maŋau
Tane maŋau afu kade ta ye ismba wam ta maye ndade ŋget. Tane kusem kaŋgermba maŋgurkade ait ta maŋau afu maye ndade. Taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu tur ndaka afu ŋaigo siglikade.
Tane Kuate tuku mbal maŋgur pilig ta tane wamdus pur yimyamkade ta afuŋge taŋamba sayade le ye ismba wam afu ta son ŋga iduset.
Ta ndaŋam? Pur yimyamkade maŋau ta son pasa mbolŋge Kuate nu Kristus tuku kuasmbi kilimok kile-mayokkate.
Tane maŋgurka tuma isukusig ta Suŋgo nu isukusam tuku maŋau siŋgina ta ke ndakade.
Tane maŋgurka kumu kumu isukuse ndakade. Tane yimyam pire pire taŋgine nyamagaŋ kilmba prode sulumba taŋgine ndek nye sulude le afu gubak minig afu grep kule suŋgomba nyumba ŋginŋgankade.

Yoi. Taŋamba isukusam ndeta taŋgine wandekŋge nyap. Ko tane Kuate tuku kuasmbi talaniŋmba afu nyamagaŋ kugatok ta kiko pileniŋgam idusmba taŋade e? Wam kade ta mbolŋge ye tane wam mayede ŋga satiŋge nda.
Ye buk pasa nyam tuku maŋau tumtiŋgen ta Suŋgoŋge sina ta teŋenmba. Yudas nu Suŋgo Yesus tumba ŋgueu mbal tuku wai mbol pilna furir ta mbolŋge ndo Suŋgo nu bret tumba
Kuate gare pasa tumba bret fetfetmba saniŋgina: Te ye tuku ŋgarosu. Tane turkam tuku tiŋget. Tane ye idusyam tuku maŋau te kumba minap ŋgina.

Nane taŋamba isukuse deŋpurnaig le nu grep kule murko ŋak tumba maŋau ndui ta ndo kina sulumba sakina: Grep kule murko ŋak te pasa kitek Kuate nu taŋgo ndoŋ katna ta alonu mayok kambim tuku ye yiŋe ndare kutuwamŋgit. Tane grep kule teŋen nyade ait ta ye idusyumba nyap ŋgina.
Suŋgo nu maŋ pro ndawa le tane bret nyumba grep kule nyade ta siŋgine Suŋgo nu sinenu ŋga kumna ta te-mayokmba saka minig.
Ta tuku ande nu Suŋgo tuku bret ko nu tuku grep kule ake fare tumba nyate ta nu mbarte. Nu Suŋgo tuku ŋgarosu ndare ŋaigo siglikate.
Ande nu tumba nyam ŋga kande nuŋe maŋau pile mayemba kile-tidiŋgumba wamdus te-mayemba bret grep kule ta kilmba nyuwa.
Ande nu Suŋgo tuku ŋgarosu idus ndamba bret grep kule ake fare kilmba nyate ta nu nyumba ta tuku pa lafunu ta tumba nuŋe ŋgaro mbolŋge pilit.
Tane ŋgamukŋge afu taŋamba kade sulumba afu baklelmba afu guaze ŋak minig afu buk kume likinaig.
Sine siŋgine maŋau siŋgine miroŋ pileŋgube ta Suŋgo nu sine pilesiŋge nda.
Nu sine pilesiŋgit ta sine kilke te tuku maŋau dubide mbal ndoŋ ŋgisi ndakube ŋga nu pitisiŋmba kile-tidiŋgate.
Tira kame, tane isukusam tuku maŋgurkade ta muŋgu minde-mindekap.
Ande nu gubawa kande nuŋe wande mbolŋge isukuswa. Tane maŋgur mbolŋge mbarap le pa lafunu tane tubekaig. Ye pasa afu minig ta yiŋe miroŋ tane tugum prowi sulumba satiŋgamŋgit.
